title: knowledge-turso moves into objectstack: Apache-2.0, the platform embedder and splitter, listing, generations, the contract suite
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child). Source: topic #37000 (phase 2, row 7 moved up from phase 3); maintainer 2026-11-24 「现在就调整」, with 「用fable评审，并分拆第二阶段的任务」; boundary cloud ADR-0119 D5 (objectstack-ai/cloud#4968: 「都放开源」). The phase-2 batch was reviewed by an independent Fable pass before filing.
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (topic) · reach: every deployment not on PostgreSQL, including `os dev` · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：把 cloud 仓库里的 libSQL 向量存储 `knowledge-turso` 搬进 objectstack 开源，改用平台的嵌入器和切分器，补上「列出文档」和换模型时的新一代索引，跑和 pgvector 同一套契约测试。
- 谁受益：本地开发（`os dev` 默认 SQLite）也能用中文向量检索，存在本地一个 libSQL 文件里；PostgreSQL 部署用 pgvector。托管云以后也用它（托管接入在阶段三第 14 行）。
- 需要你做的：无。从 cloud 仓库删掉旧包是另一张 cloud 卡，这张落地后由维护者会话处理。

## What
Source: cloud `packages/knowledge-turso` (origin/main): libSQL native vectors (`F32_BLOB` + DiskANN `libsql_vector_idx`); URL `libsql://`, `file:` or `:memory:`, or a client passed in; its own `OpenAIEmbeddingProvider` (`src/embedding.ts`); one table per source, `knowledge_`` <source.id>ˋ ``, with `chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY` (`${documentId}#${idx}`), `document_id`, `source_record_id`, `content`, `title`, `metadata`, `embedding F32_BLOB(<dim>)`; its own chunker (`chunkTarget`, 800).
1. `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso` (new in objectstack). `LICENSE` is Apache-2.0 text (today the cloud package's `LICENSE` holds BSL 1.1 text while `package.json` and headers say Apache-2.0; ADR-0119 D5 settles it). Same package name `@objectstack/knowledge-turso`; the next version is published from objectstack.
2. Embedder: drop `src/embedding.ts`; use `EMBEDDER_SERVICE` (#37094 registers it in the open edition) or a constructor `embedder: IEmbedder`.
3. Chunks: drop its own chunker; take the service's chunks (#37098) and declare that it accepts them.
4. Layout changes the contract needs (today's layout has no hash, organization or generation):
   - One table per source and generation, `knowledge_``` <source.id> ```_g<n>` (the vector column's dimension is fixed per table, so a model with another dimension needs a new table anyway), plus a generation table: `source_id`, `generation`, `fingerprint`, `dim`, `model`, `state`, `created_at`.
   - Columns added: `doc_hash` (for `listDocuments`, #37096), `chunk_hash` (unchanged text is not re-embedded), `organization_id` (filtered before ranking from `organizationIds`, #37097).
   - Chunk ids stay `${documentId}#${idx}`, unique inside a generation table; they are not citation anchors.
   - A legacy `knowledge_```` <source.id>ˋ ```` table (no generation) is treated as stale: search answers "reindex needed"; it is dropped after the first new generation is active.
5. Fingerprint: the one #37001 defines, handed in by the service (same member #37100 reads). Mismatch → "reindex needed", as in #37100. A build (#37099's trigger) writes a new generation table; when the walk ends, #37096's purge reconciles, the generation becomes active, the old table is dropped. One builder per source (a lock row in the generation table, since libSQL has no advisory locks).
6. Implements `listDocuments` (#37096). Runs the #37096 contract suite in CI on `file:` and `:memory:` libSQL (no special image); the PR confirms `@libsql/client` vector functions (`vector32`, `vector_top_k`) work on the CI runner.
7. Default local location when the runtime mounts it (#37102): a libSQL file beside the dev database under `.objectstack/data/`, configurable.
8. Docs: `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` adapter section, `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`.

## Acceptance
- The #37096 suite passes on `file:` and `:memory:`.
- Chinese text indexed and found with a fixed fake embedder.
- Same content re-indexed → no embed call.
- Model changed (same and different dimension) → new generation table, old one not served, then dropped.
- Two organizations never see each other's hits.
- A legacy table → "reindex needed", then replaced.
- Container run per AGENTS.md.

## Out of scope
- Removing the package from the cloud repo (a cloud card, filed and done by the maintainer's session after this lands).
- Hosted kernel registration (row 14, phase 3).
- Typed filters (row 11).
- Changing `os dev`'s default database (#37106 evaluates it; this store runs on its own libSQL file either way).

Blocked-by: #37001, #37096, #37098, #37097 (organization member).
Parent: #37000. Reader: `domain:server` lane (`packages/plugins/knowledge-*`).
Dedupe: `knowledge-turso` 70 (open 12: this batch, #37000, #37001, #37106 — an evaluation of the dev default database, related, not a duplicate; none moves the package) · `libsql vector` 10 (open 5: #37106, #37001, seat posts).
